name: Demo region 1
subtitle: Nordic & Baltic rim
summary: The countries around the Baltic and the North Atlantic that share long winters, high trust in institutions and small open economies. Cuts across the Atlas regions on purpose: the Baltic states sit here rather than with Central Europe.

name: Demo region 2
subtitle: Alpine & Danube basin
summary: Everything draining into the Danube plus the Alpine states around its headwaters. A watershed, not a political bloc, which is why it mixes EU founders, newer members and candidates.

name: Demo region 3
subtitle: Western Mediterranean arc
summary: Both shores of the western Mediterranean, from the Atlantic mouth to the Italian peninsula. Deliberately spans Europe and North Africa, which the standard regional split keeps apart.

name: Demo region 4
subtitle: Black Sea & Caucasus
summary: The littoral of one sea and the mountain barrier behind it — the region where European, Russian and Turkish spheres meet and grind against each other.

name: Demo region 5
subtitle: Gulf & Horn of Africa
summary: The Arabian Peninsula together with the African coast facing it across the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden — one trade corridor, two continents.

name: Demo region 6
subtitle: Sahel belt
summary: The band between the Sahara and the savannah, from the Atlantic to the Red Sea. It runs straight through the usual North Africa / Sub-Saharan boundary, which is exactly the point.

name: Demo region 7
subtitle: Himalaya & Central Asia
summary: The high interior of Asia and the states that ring it — landlocked, mountainous, and shaped by the distance to any coastline.

name: Demo region 8
subtitle: Mekong & maritime Asia
summary: Mainland Southeast Asia along the Mekong plus the archipelagos beyond it — the world's densest cluster of shipping lanes and contested waters.

name: Demo region 9
subtitle: Andes & Southern Cone
summary: The Pacific spine of South America and the temperate south below it — one mountain chain, a shared commodity cycle and a shared history of boom and default.

name: Demo region 10
subtitle: North Atlantic
summary: The states facing each other across the North Atlantic. A security and trade space rather than a geographic one, which is why it puts North America and the British Isles in the same block.
